Bank Of Baroda LBO Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the Notification for the post Local Bank Officer LBO. This recruitment was released for 2482 posts. Applications for the Bank of Baroda LBO Recruitment 2026 has Started from 18 August 2026, & Candidate can apply until 07 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank Of Baroda LBO Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 18 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
